Body.Content:
Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the calendar view on Teams panels and MTR-Android. In Pro Management Portal, admins can toggle the "Show Organizer Name" setting ON or OFF. On the panel device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names" setting ON or OFF. On the MTRA console device and All In One Display device, admins can toggle the "Show organizer names on calendar" setting ON or OFF. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown on the calendar view on panel and MTRA devices. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Space licenses.

GA date: October CY2026
